entities.summary: Konstantin Valerievich Rudenko is a former Kazakhstani-Russian professional ice hockey winger who played in the Russian Superleague and Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Philadelphia Flyers in the 6th round of the 1999 NHL Entry Draft.
